defaults.notes: All remote entries point at public GitHub repository trees (raw blob API / codeload). No hot-linked CDN is required. Every path below was verified to return a real binary (not an LFS pointer).

procedural_fallbacks.note: Any manifest entry that fails to download and load is substituted at runtime by a generated texture (procedural sprite) or by the WebAudio synthesiser, so the game never blocks.
